---
title: "Packaging & installers"
---

## Python package (`pyproject.toml`)

From the **repository root** (where `pyproject.toml` lives — not `eye-tracking/`):

```bash
cd /path/to/FaceGate   # or: projet-face-recog-main
python -m pip install -e ".[build]"
facegate   # launches the desktop app
```

Editable install puts `common` and `app` on the path (packages under `eye-tracking/`).

## PyInstaller (portable binary)

```bash
pip install -e ".[build]"
bash scripts/build_pyinstaller.sh        # Linux / macOS
scripts\build_pyinstaller.bat            # Windows
```

Output: `dist/FaceGate/` (onedir) or `dist/FaceGate` (onefile, depending on the `.spec`).

The entry point freezes `eye-tracking/app/run_desktop.py` so Tkinter + OpenCV start without a separate Python install. InsightFace model weights still download on first run if missing.

## `.deb` (Debian / Ubuntu)

After a successful PyInstaller build:

```bash
bash scripts/build_deb.sh
```

Requires [`fpm`](https://fpm.readthedocs.io/) (`gem install fpm` or distro package). Produces `dist/facegate_*.deb` installing under `/opt/facegate` with a `facegate` wrapper in `/usr/local/bin`.

## `.msi` (Windows)

1. Build with `scripts\build_pyinstaller.bat`
2. Wrap `dist\FaceGate\` with [WiX](https://wixtoolset.org/) or [Inno Setup](https://jrsoftware.org/isinfo.php)

A minimal Inno Setup script is provided at `packaging/FaceGate.iss`. Open it in Inno Setup Compiler and build the installer (`.exe` setup; WiX can produce a true `.msi` if required by your deployment policy).

## Gallery backup

```bash
cd eye-tracking
python face-recognition/gallery_io.py export -o ~/facegate-gallery.zip
python face-recognition/gallery_io.py import -i ~/facegate-gallery.zip
# replace entire gallery:
python face-recognition/gallery_io.py import -i ~/facegate-gallery.zip --replace
```

Treat ZIP exports as **biometric personal data** (see [Privacy & GDPR](privacy.qmd)).
